Burst into tears and run on the 2nd line

There's still a mountain of hurdles ahead. But... having given my all even for a moment,
I saw hope. I will believe in myself!

Lamenting my raw material won't pave the way forward.
Even if I couldn't love it, I could never separate myself from 'me.'

!
...Trainer.

The hardships ahead may be beyond anything I can imagine. Even so,
I will make North Flight's raw material—her potential—truly shine, no matter what.

...Heh, just kidding.
Come on, Fu-chan, style yourself in positivity. It's okay, because I am—

...You're right. I... was thinking the same thing.
Then let's proceed with training under that plan!

—I want to adorn myself with an unprecedented brilliance.
To do that, I also need the perspective of someone I can trust.

Trainer!
I... —

Because of my constitution, every teacher and trainer told me...
even if I debuted, making an impact would be nearly impossible.

Looking at her training performance and records up to now...
the number derived was the final 200m—nothing more.

...Hehe... Giggles.
Phew~...

I wanted to steer her into taking a breather as naturally as possible...
but from her reaction, it seems she's seen right through all my intentions.

...She's truly a strong girl. She always tells me, 'It's all thanks to you'...
but all I ever did was share knowledge with her.

...Along the way, I kept fashion magazines close at hand.
I wanted to understand what she loved and ensure her mental care was flawless too.

Although she possesses the potential to vie for a Triple Crown, her body currently can't handle it.
So, for now, our primary focus should be—

...He, hehe... Ahaha.
All right, let's go find some hidden gems♪

(—Whenever I run, my legs always ache to push harder. I want to accelerate more, and more.
I know I can do it... but)

For trying to help her.
Because I won't be able to stay right by her side anymore.

I'm just so happy, I'm sob-sobbing, I can't...!
Waaahhh, thank you, everyoneee!!

(I *do* have a full 200m.
To showcase my true brilliance—that's more than enough!)

Just staring into the mirror and letting out sighs...
won't change a single thing.

Ah! Trainer...
...Oh, sorry for making you worry the other day. But I'm—

I will find the ensemble that lets my natural qualities shine brightest.
So that I can truly fall in love with 'myself'—

The brilliant display of speed North Flight showed the very next moment—
a breathtaking burst as if she were taking flight—is something I will never forget.

We take the longer medium distances off the table for now and narrow our focus to short distances.
And among those, rather than sprints that demand maintaining peak velocity throughout—

(Even the dream of the Japanese Derby, if it's Ticket-san...
If it's Ticket-san, then...—)

...Yes.
I—I think so too!
Heeeeyyyy, Fliiiight!!

Choosing to look forward and never give up... that was all her doing.
Do you know what Fuu-chan's 'aesthetic' is—?

(—It's all right. Enduring is what I do best...
Once we hit the final straight...—)

That bakushin-like speed... Truly, you are my rival!
Let us settle which of us is the most bakushin in the Twinkle Series!

Precisely because of her delicate constitution, she's reflected deeply and grown.
With her natural speed and brilliant intellect... her potential is limitless.

!
...Ehehe.

(And I only pushed myself a tiny bit, too.
...Oh well. I'll just dial the workload back down—)

...When that time comes...
will I just be watching from the sidelines too?

...'For now', right? Understood!
Here I go!
Huh...—
You are... without a doubt, the perfect Trainer for Fuu-chan.

Centering on the mile, where she can catch her breath midway... The crux of styling her is
clearly distinguishing between sprints and miles within the short-distance category.

...Are you sure?
There's no guarantee such a day will ever come.

—!!
Yaaaaaaah...!!

I'm sure I'll cause you plenty of trouble. But... will you continue
to provide me with wonderful styling going forward?

...Yep, no dizziness either.
I'm all good now.

Fufufufu... Aaaahahahaha!!
I saw it, Flight-san! With these wide-open eyes, crystal clear!

Thanks for the other day~~! Thanks to you, I leveled up like crazy—!
I won the categorized meet and my debut is officially set--!!

Haa... haa... wheeze.........
Phew............ Heh.

(I see, Ticket-san... is making her debut.
With such wonderful qualities, she's bound to achieve great things.)
...Big sis.

Never lamenting who I am. Loving the self I was born as.
And adorning myself in the way that makes me shine brightest.

After North Flight collapsed... I visited the training club she used to attend,
conveyed my current feelings to 'Big Sis', and asked for her cooperation—
Haa... haa... haa...!

Believing that there's something you can do.
Having that faith in her will surely give her strength.

From that day on, our trial-and-error journey began
to enable North Flight to 'run at full throttle.'
—Make the mile our primary focus, you say?

—Haa... haa... Huh? Are we taking our break over here today?
This isn't our usual course, is it?

In between supervising her training, I studied her childhood records
borrowed from 'Big Sis' and even dug through medical textbooks.

And so, step by step, North Flight and I carried on our preparations...
until one day, after some time had passed.
